_warm_note: One connected claude process is kept per conversation and reused across turns (measured ~1.3 s/turn vs ~4 s with spawn+resume). Closed after idle_close_s without a turn, or LRU beyond max_warm.

stt._keyterms_note: Nova-3 keyterm biasing of the spoken command phrases made Deepgram drop all punctuation (tested); proper nouns are fine.

tts.instructions: You are reading a thoughtful friend's side of a relaxed conversation aloud. Natural, calm, unhurried, warm; not salesy or performative. Pause briefly between sentences.

voice._timeout_note: Countdown starts when the last transcript arrives (so add ~1-2 s of VAD hang-off + STT latency to feel it). unfinished_extra_s is added when the composer text does not end in terminal punctuation, i.e. Deepgram thinks you are mid-sentence. Tuning history: started at 4 s, which sent half-thoughts whenever you paused to think; raised in steps, then settled on a flat 20 s regardless of punctuation after finished-looking sentences were still sent mid-thought. "go ahead" is the escape hatch, so a long wait costs nothing when you are actually done.
voice._mic_note: Chrome noise suppression makes Deepgram return unpunctuated transcripts (tested); Nova-3 copes with noise on its own.
